findings.finding: Whole practice shows some advantages over part practice in certain contexts.
findings.quote: There were indications that whole practice had some advantages over part practice and random practice was superior to blocked practice on post-acquisition tests.

findings.finding: The specific order of part-practice can influence and directionally bias the performance of the whole task.
findings.quote: Such findings suggest that the part-practice order of bimanual tasks can directionally bias whole-task performance.

principle: Research indicates that whole practice can have some advantages over part practice, while the specific order of part-practice can also bias subsequent performance.
for_the_teacher: Integrate whole-practice runs alongside part-practice to leverage its advantages for motor learning.
Be mindful of how breaking down movements into parts might bias the execution of the complete movement later.
